genotype_to_drug_rule: Fits Kover 2.0.7 Set Covering Machine (conjunction and disjunction, max 6 rules, p in {0.1, 0.316, 0.562, 1.0, 1.778, 3.162, 10.0}, 3-fold inner CV) strictly inside each outer training fold and predicts 0/1 on outer test genomes.

i_handling.description: Kover SCM fits binary R/S rules inside outer training folds without an I category; any uncalled or failed test genome is counted separately and never mapped to S.
